title: Planar fibre geometry: projection formula, the sector point and uniqueness of the planar fibre point
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P (Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2) and a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0. Write π := Q.starProjection (orthogonal projection onto Q), p_T := T.starProjection for a linear subspace T, Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a and f(x) := arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩). Then (a) |p_T(Ax)| ≤ |πx| ≤ |x| for every linear subspace T ⊆ ℝ^P and every x ∈ ℝ^P; and for all real t > 0 and α with |α| < Real.pi/2 (Real.pi is the circle constant; π denotes the projection), the point x₀ := t(cos α·a + sin α·e) satisfies (b) ⟨x₀, a⟩ > 0, |x₀| = t, f(x₀) = α, πx₀ = x₀ and |π(Ax₀)| = t, and (c) every x ∈ ℝ^P with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, |x| = t, f(x) = α and x ≠ x₀ satisfies |πx| < t.
